title: Practice Checkout
description: Welcome to the Practice Checkout! No real money is used here. Your goal is to check if this store is real, and if it is, pick the safest way to pay.

challenges.justInTimeHint: Double-check the spelling in the address bar at the top.
The address looks perfectly spelled. Which payment method protects you the most?

gentleFailureFakeSite.title: Excellent Practice!
gentleFailureFakeSite.message: Spotting tiny spelling differences takes practice, and you are doing exactly what you need to learn! The address 'amaz0n-update-store.com' had a small typo. Always take your time to check the top of the screen. Let's try another one together!

gentleFailureUnsafePayment.title: Great Attention to the Address!
gentleFailureUnsafePayment.message: You correctly saw it was the real store, which is fantastic! For payment, remember that Credit Cards provide the strongest safety net since they use the bank's money. It is a great habit to use them for online shopping. Let's keep practicing!

success.title: Perfectly Done!
success.message: You checked the website address perfectly, and you picked the safest payment method. You are becoming a very confident online shopper!
